title: aster hortensis
intro: Aster hortensis, commonly known as the Purple Coneflower, is a perennial flowering plant native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Aster hortensis include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which have been used to treat various health issues, such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
